Market today: The mood is cautious, even bearish, for tech and AI. Rising bond yields and fears of an 'AI borrowing binge' are the real drivers, making growth stocks less attractive and sparking 'bubble put' buying. This directly impacts your concentrated tech/chip book, especially leveraged positions.

Your holdings: SOXL (-50.82%), MUU (-28.77%), and SPAL (-32.05%) are leveraged ETFs with deep drawdowns and 'SELL' statuses – these are your biggest immediate concerns, amplified by margin. SMCI (-18.46%) is also a 'SELL' and has breached its stop.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields and any further news on 'enterprise AI timing' or AI sector valuation concerns. These factors will continue to dictate the direction for your core holdings.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management in your leveraged and underperforming tech positions to protect capital.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is invalid as price is 110.54. Given the -50.82% loss and 'SELL' status, consider a significant trim or exit to reduce leveraged exposure.
SMCI: Price 35.78 is below your 37.3 stop, indicating it's triggered. Respect the 'SELL' status and consider exiting SMCI to manage this loss.
MUU & SPAL: Both are leveraged 'SELLs' with deep losses. Review their stops and consider trimming to reduce overall leveraged risk in this market.
